Class ShownComponentsController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.ui.gui.otherControllers.ShownComponentsController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GuiController
public class ShownComponentsController extends Object implements GuiController
Controller for the Shown Components screen in the Galaxy Trucker game. This controller manages the display of components available to players, allows selection of components, and handles user interactions.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the controller, setting up the component grid and loading images. Also sets up the pick button and back button actions.

    • showGameState

      public void showGameState(String message)
      Displays the current game state in the gameStateLabel.
      Parameters:
      message - The message to display in the game state label.

    • showError

      public void showError(String message)
      Displays an error message in the errorLabel and errorBackground. The error message fades in, stays visible for 3 seconds, and then fades out.
      Parameters:
      message - The error message to display.

    • updateShownComponents

      public void updateShownComponents(int imageID, boolean released)
      Updates the displayed components in the component grid based on the provided image ID and release status. If released is true, it adds the component to the grid; if false, it removes the component from the grid.
      Parameters:
      imageID - The ID of the component image to be updated.
      released - Indicates whether the component is being released (added) or not (removed).

    • notifyError

      public void notifyError(String message)
      Notifies the controller about an error, displaying it in the error label. This method is called by the server to inform the client about errors.
      Specified by:
      notifyError in interface GuiController
      Parameters:
      message - The error message to display.

    • setupPickButton

      public void setupPickButton()
      Sets up the pick button to handle component selection. When clicked, it retrieves the selected component index and sends a pick request to the server.

    • setUpBackButton

      public void setUpBackButton()
      Sets up the back button to return to the previous screen. It loads the appropriate ShipBuildingController based on the game type (first flight or second flight).

    • getSelectedComponentIndex

      public Integer getSelectedComponentIndex()
      Gets the index of the currently selected component in the component grid. If no component is selected, it returns null.
      Returns:
      The index of the selected component, or null if no component is selected.

    • clearSelection

      public void clearSelection()
      Clears the selection of the currently selected component. If a component is selected, it removes the glow effect and disables the pick button.

    • setGameType

      public void setGameType(boolean firstFlight)
      Sets the game type (first flight or second flight) for the controller. This determines which ship building screen to load when the back button is pressed.
      Parameters:
      firstFlight - True if it's the first flight, false if it's the second flight.

    • setControlledStage

      public void setControlledStage(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Sets the controlled stage for the controller. This is used to change the scene when navigating back to the ship building screen.
      Specified by:
      setControlledStage in interface GuiController
      Parameters:
      stage - The Stage to be controlled by this controller.

    • setServer

      public void setServer(VirtualServer server)

      Specified by:
      setServer in interface GuiController
      Parameters:

    • setPlayerInfo

      public void setPlayerInfo(int gameID, String playerNickname, Color color)
      Sets the player information for the controller, including game ID, player nickname, and color. This is used to identify the player when sending requests to the server.
      Specified by:
      setPlayerInfo in interface GuiController
      Parameters:
      gameID - The ID of the game.
      playerNickname - The nickname of the player.
      color - The color associated with the player.
